title: Rust: Max of Three
description: Find the maximum of three numbers using comparison logic.

steps.title: Max of Two
steps.description: Write a function `max2(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32` that returns the larger of two numbers. Call with 8 and 15, print result.
hints: The if/else expression returns a value.

steps.title: Max of Three with Nested If
steps.description: Write a function `max3(a: i32, b: i32, c: i32) -> i32` using nested if/else. Call with 7, 42, 15 and print.
hints: First compare a and b, then compare the result with c.
`let max = if a > b { a } else { b };` then compare max with c.

steps.title: Max with std::cmp::max
steps.description: Use `std::cmp::max` to find the max of two numbers, then chain to find max of three: `max(max(a, b), c)`. Call with 100, 50, 75.

verification.failureMessage: Use std::cmp::max to find the maximum of 100, 50, 75.

steps.title: Max from Array
steps.description: Find the maximum value in the array `[33, 78, 12, 99, 45, 67]` using `.iter().max()`. Print the result.

verification.failureMessage: Find and print the maximum in [33, 78, 12, 99, 45, 67].

steps.title: Min of Three
steps.description: Write a function `min3(a: i32, b: i32, c: i32) -> i32` that returns the smallest of three. Call with 10, 3, 7 and print.
hints: Similar to max, but use `<` instead of `>`.
`if a < b { a } else { b }` for min of two.
